description: Create a new preview restoring applied reversible changes from an edit. Returns not_reversible for archive and delete. Does not apply the undo. In review mode the undo keeps the original run title and note, prefixed "Undo:", unless you pass runTitle or reason; pass reviewId to add it to an existing review. Both preview detail levels report settings.launch (allowed, approval or off) separately from the edit mode; settings.approvalRuleAppliesTo is edits. Edit approval does not gate new-ad launches. Review mode returns reviewUrl and no executable plan. Share reviewUrl with the user, do not apply, and reuse reviewId on later previews in the same conversation. EDITS_REVIEW_REQUIRED means approval must happen in your Agent Inbox. Always preview and show the user the changes. Set a confirm flag only after the user explicitly approves that change. Never retry a partial apply blindly. Archive and delete cannot be undone. Preview requests accept optional reason and runTitle. A per-operation reason overrides the top-level reason for that operation. Use one short evidence-based note for the Agent Inbox and reuse runTitle with the same reviewId.

reason.description: One short note for the user explaining why (shown in their Agent Inbox). Defaults to the original note with one "Undo: " prefix.

reviewId.description: Add the undo to this existing review instead of starting a new one.

runTitle.description: Optional one-line title for this undo. Defaults to "Undo: " plus the original run title, keeping an existing prefix.

name: ads_edit_undo
title: Preview an Undo
